overview: Minimal scikit-learn variation used to validate Kaggle model creation and notebook attachment flows.
usage:
# Model Format

joblib serialized scikit-learn estimator.

# Training Data

Trained on scikit-learn's built-in iris dataset.

# Model Inputs

A 2D float array with four numeric flower measurements per row.

# Model Outputs

Integer class ids from 0 to 2.

# Model Usage

Load with `joblib.load()` and call `.predict()` on a matrix of shape `(n_samples, 4)`.

# Fine-tuning

Not intended for fine-tuning.

# Changelog

Initial badge automation variation.
